name: Create credential
description: Create credential Creates a new credential within a credential set. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/credential_sets/{credential_set_id}/credentials
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/credential_sets/{credential_set_id}/credentials
Creates a new credential within a credential set.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; credential_set_id (path) — Credential set identifier.; body (body)

name: Create credential set
description: Create credential set Creates a new credential set. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/credential_sets
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/credential_sets
Creates a new credential set.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; body (body)

name: Create scan
description: Create scan Creates and starts a new vulnerability scan. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/scans
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/scans
Creates and starts a new vulnerability scan. The response may include non-fatal warnings in the `messages` array.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; body (body)

name: Create target environment
description: Create target environment Creates a new target environment for the account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/target_environments
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/target_environments
Creates a new target environment for the account.
Required: account_id (path) — Account identifier.; body (body)

name: Delete credential

name: Delete credential set

name: Delete scan
description: Delete scan Deletes a scan and all associated data. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/scans/{scan_id}

name: Delete target environment
description: Delete target environment Removes a target environment. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/vuln_scanner/target_environments/{target_environment_id}
